# Biblical Job

The biblical telling, Jung’s interpretation and Taylor’s three-office reading retain separate attribution. Job’s narrated land and divine council belong to the story; modern interpretive settings remain distinct. The KJV digital witness, the biblical narrative and Jung’s later reception have separate temporal offices.

The [geographical route](../../atlas/geography/README.md) and [temporal route](../../atlas/temporality/README.md) **returns-to** these same wholes.
